description: A style of organizing code: how state, control flow and communication between parts are expressed.
Step-by-step statements that change state (`for` loops, assignments). Says *how*.
Describes the desired result and lets an engine decide how: SQL, array methods, Zod schemas, JSX.
Pure functions, immutable data and composition. Easy to test and reason about.
Objects bundle state and behavior behind interfaces; implementations are swappable (polymorphism).
Code reacts to events emitted over time (`EventEmitter`, streams, queues). Node's native style.
